title: destroy leaves each member's recorded agent session on the host
foundBy: session agent working in the simple-tools-demo repository, which runs a three member campaign at the pinned build of 2026-09-17, after the previous session in that repository lost a day to the failure this causes
details:
`cs-campaign destroy` removes the members and the campaign record. It leaves the host's record of each member's agent session under `~/.cs-<cli>-remote-sessions`. After destroying a three member opencode campaign called `hello`, nine files named `hello-<id>-<member>` were still there, and three of them were `.token` files.

The leftovers change what the next create does. `hostSessionFresh` in `internal/cli/sandbox.go` treats a present marker as a session to resume. The campaign id is the profile digest, so creating the same profile again produces the same session names. The turn driver then drives the old session id against a brand new member.

The previous session in the demo repository reported what follows. Every turn failed with `TUI server does not know session`, and that surfaced as `opencode TUI exited during startup (port NNNNN in use, or launch failure)`. The message blames ports and startup, so three runs were spent there. This session did not reproduce that failure, because the demo now deletes the markers before each create. It did confirm the leftovers and the code path.

The sandbox tools already ship `cs-<cli>-remote-forget`. `destroy` could call it for each member, and the startup error could name a stale session as a cause.

To reproduce, create and destroy any opencode campaign, then run `ls ~/.cs-opencode-remote-sessions | grep <campaign-name>`.
